authority: original Auth/Owner/project/derived/source/budget and expiry fences; GET has no launch/write path

errors.404: not_found (wrong Owner, missing material, not ready/publication absent)

excluded: runtime filesystem paths in package metadata beyond original saved provenance

limits.heatmap_inputs: four exact original publication inputs including full matrix.tsv; never output heatmap-matrix.tsv as source
limits.scripts: both fixed original R scripts exact bytes pinned by original SCRIPT constants; no selectable script/path
limits.zip_images: SVG only; PNG/PDF excluded, including original PNG preview

manifest.files: object keyed by every other fixed ZIP entry; values exact {bytes,sha256}; no arbitrary names
manifest.manifest_self_hash: literal covered_by_archive_sha256_header; self-excluded to avoid circular hash
manifest.method: original plot-only provenance/expected R and package versions/original scripts and exact Rscript argv; original R-session.txt retained

notes: README supplies current-kind exact Rscript invocation; both original scripts retained, other-kind inputs not fabricated. Original scripts may regenerate PNG locally; archive does not contain it.
path: canonical_uuid IDs; exact ASCII raw path, no root_path, alias, percent-encoding, doubled or trailing slash
ready_definition: original Owner verified complete saved publication; no demo/fallback or input reconstruction

headers.Content-Length: exact ZIP byte length as decimal
headers.X-Cyomics-File-SHA256: lowercase64 hex SHA256 of complete ZIP
